problems: Colony overlap: turco-egyptian-sudan, equatoria-province and habesh-eyalet (type colony) cover land inside Cliopatria's muhammad-ali-dynasty, khedivate-of-egypt and ottoman-empire shapes. The me-10 dossiers must name these slugs as counterparts for their Sudan, Eritrean-coast and Harar events, and the renderer must tint the colonies as vassals of the metropole and subtract them from the metropole shapes, or the land is drawn twice. The Hejaz half of habesh-eyalet (infobox area includes it) needs a decision from the Ottoman dossier.

Gazetteer: 4 region names (Damot, Kaffa, Gimirra, Hadiya) and about 27 place names are missing; the dossiers use coordinates (lon/lat/km) for places and approximate radii for the regions, so the resolve warnings (equatoria 3, damot 6, kaffa 9, hadiya 8) are the unknown region names only.

Gazetteer: Natural Earth's Eritrean admin-1 names are scrambled (e.g. 'Semenawi Keyih Bahri' resolves to the Anseba region, 'Debub' to the Northern Red Sea region); the EPLF dossier avoids them and uses country, Gash Barka, places and coordinates only. The gazetteer agent should check Eritrea's admin-1.

Sibling disagreements (each dossier's notes field has the page quotes): Kaffa gain 1900 (ethiopian-empire) vs 1897 (Kaffa page); Jimma tributary 1881 (ethiopian-empire) vs vassal of Shewa 1884 and Ethiopia 1889 (Jimma page); Harar annexation 6 Jan 1887 (ethiopian-empire) vs 9 Jan 1887 (Chelenqo page); Hadiya's 1889 gain in ethiopian-empire names 'nobody' but should name hadiya-sultanate; Funj gain of Fazughli 1665 (funj-sultanate) vs 1685 (Fazughli page); Taqali vassal_start 1665 (funj-sultanate) vs founding 1750 and no 'vassal' on the page; Shaigiya takes Dongola 1782 (funj-sultanate) vs Dar Shaigiya independent c. 1690 (Shaiqiya page); adal-sultanate has Harar independent in 1577 while the Aussa page keeps Harar in the Imamate until 1647; the makuria dossier cites a Banu Kanz sentence (control from Aydhab and Suakin west to the Nile) that was not in the page text returned in this run.

String match: the mahdist-state dossier's counterpart 'Equatoria Province' is this batch's equatoria-province; the funj-sultanate counterpart 'Shaigiya (Shaykiyya)' is shaigiya and 'abdallab' is abdallab (the 1504-1821 vassal years agree); 'sultanate-of-shewa' and 'hadiya-sultanate' agree with ifat-sultanate and ethiopian-empire.

Dating: WebFetch returns summarised page text, so many starts/ends (Kerma, Dʿmt, Blemmyes, Ajuran, Damot, Hadiya, Mogadishu, Hiraab) are century placeholders at confidence 1-2; the Dervish end and Banu Kanz 1365 loss are confidence 2 on the page's wording.
Wikidata ids are null throughout: wikidata.org is unreachable and no opened page gives them.
Cliopatria's New Kingdom shape (new-kingdom-of-egypt, -1500..-801) already covers Egyptian Nubia, so no Viceroyalty of Kush dossier was written.
